question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Graetar**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the word in option 4 is incorrect.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is 'Greater', with an 'e' instead of an 'a'.
 
• The incorrect spelling 'Graetar' has an extra 'a' in the middle.
 
• "Greater" means large in amount, degree, size, etc.; a lot of. (मात्रा, आकार आदि में बड़ा; बहुत अधिक)
 
 
• Example: Greater demand for high-quality coffee has helped drive coffee prices higher. 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: 'Decrease' is correctly spelled and means to become smaller or less.(घटाना)
 
• Option 2: 'Rocking' is correctly spelled and means moving back and forth or shaking.(कमाल)
 
• Option 3: 'Frame' is correctly spelled and can mean a structure that holds something in place or a decorative border around a picture or photograph.(चौखटा)
